name: Freya
oneLiner: Voice AI agents for financial services.
summary: Freya has raised $3.5 million in new funding to accelerate the adoption of its human-like voice automation platform, attracting support from DOMiNO Ventures, Y Combinator, Formosa Capital, and others.

name: Series
oneLiner: Series: AI-powered social network matching founders and mentors.
linkLabel: How two Yale juniors raised $3.1M - Forbes
summary: New Haven-based start-up Series is a social network founded by two students at one of the US's most prestigious colleges. But if that makes you think of another well-known social network launched in similar fashion some 20 years ago, co-founders Nathaneo Johnson and Sean Hargrow are keen to put you right.

name: Nerd Apply
oneLiner: Privacy-first data platform for college admissions counseling.
linkLabel: Raises $3.2M seed funding - EdTech Innovation Hub
summary: Nerd Apply, a college counseling platform, has raised $3.2 million in seed funding to scale and increase its security, compliance and infrastructure.

name: Cloak
oneLiner: Protects online publisher content against AI scraping.
summary: The University of Pennsylvania's Venture Lab is proud to announce the winner of its tenth annual Startup Challenge: Cloak, founded by Rishi Ambavanekar and Tyler Sacharow. Cloak works with publishers, ranging from news to novels to screenplays, to protect content against AI scraping.

name: Doe

summary: Doe is where AI agents actually do your work. Connect your tools, tell Doe what you need, and agents handle it.

summary: Music has long captivated the human mind, transcending cultural boundaries and personal backgrounds. For some, it represents pure emotion and expression.
